title: Monteur
description: A technician (Monteur) executing meter-change jobs. The optional passwortHash field is only used by disposition-web-app for offline tablet login; freitag-webapp persists Monteure without it.

id.description: Stable identifier. UUID v4 in freitag-webapp (Postgres), MongoDB ObjectId-string in disposition-web-app.

passwortHash.description: Salted password hash (ASP.NET PasswordHasher format). Set only in disposition-web-app since Phase 0. Must NEVER be exposed in JSON responses — implementations must use @JsonIgnore / DTO projection.

aktiv.description: Whether the Monteur can be assigned new orders.
